description: Comprehensive dog body language signals database compiled from veterinary ethology research
sources: American Kennel Club (AKC) body language guide
Dr. Sophia Yin - Body Language of Fear in Dogs
Patricia McConnell - For the Love of a Dog
Stanley Coren - How to Speak Dog
Journal of Veterinary Behavior research papers

high_fast_wag.label: High, Fast Wag
high_fast_wag.description: Tail held high with rapid side-to-side movement
high_fast_wag.context_notes: Generally positive but can indicate high arousal. Check body tension - stiff body + high fast wag can mean overstimulation.

high_slow_wag.label: High, Slow Wag
high_slow_wag.description: Tail held high with deliberate, slow side-to-side movement
high_slow_wag.context_notes: Dog is evaluating the situation. Not necessarily friendly - may be deciding how to react.

high_stiff.label: High and Stiff
high_stiff.description: Tail held rigid and vertical with minimal movement
high_stiff.context_notes: Warning signal. Dog is asserting dominance or feeling threatened. Do not approach without caution.

mid_relaxed_wag.label: Natural Position, Relaxed Wag
mid_relaxed_wag.description: Tail at natural resting height with gentle, loose wag
mid_relaxed_wag.context_notes: Most reliable indicator of a happy, relaxed dog. The whole backend often moves with the tail.

mid_helicopter.label: Helicopter Wag
mid_helicopter.description: Tail spinning in full circles, whole body wiggling
mid_helicopter.context_notes: Reserved for greetings and extreme joy. Very reliable positive signal.

low_slow_wag.label: Low, Slow Wag
low_slow_wag.description: Tail held low with tentative, slow wagging
low_slow_wag.context_notes: Dog is unsure but trying to be friendly. May be anxious about the interaction.

low_stiff.label: Low and Stiff
low_stiff.description: Tail held low and rigid, close to hind legs
low_stiff.context_notes: Dog is experiencing stress. Give them space and remove stressors.

tucked.label: Tucked Between Legs
tucked.description: Tail tucked tightly against belly between hind legs
tucked.context_notes: Strong fear or extreme submission. Dog feels very threatened. Do not approach - let them retreat.

forward_erect.label: Forward and Erect
forward_erect.context_notes: Dog is focused on something. Could be curiosity or preparation for action.

slightly_forward.label: Slightly Forward
slightly_forward.description: Ears tilted slightly forward from natural position
slightly_forward.context_notes: Interested and engaged. Common during positive interactions.

relaxed_natural.label: Natural/Relaxed
relaxed_natural.description: Ears in their natural resting position
relaxed_natural.context_notes: Dog is comfortable and at ease in their environment.

slightly_back.label: Slightly Back
slightly_back.description: Ears pulled slightly back from natural position
slightly_back.context_notes: Often a friendly, appeasing gesture. Common during greetings.

pinned_flat.label: Pinned Flat Against Head
pinned_flat.description: Ears pressed tightly against the skull
pinned_flat.context_notes: Strong fear or extreme submission. Combined with other fear signals, dog needs space.

one_forward_one_back.label: One Forward, One Back
one_forward_one_back.context_notes: Dog is processing mixed signals or conflicting emotions.

play_bow.label: Play Bow
play_bow.description: Front end lowered with elbows on ground, rear end raised, tail usually wagging
play_bow.context_notes: Universal dog play invitation. One of the most reliable signals. Often accompanied by excited barks.

standing_relaxed.label: Relaxed Standing
standing_relaxed.description: Weight evenly distributed, muscles relaxed, mouth slightly open
standing_relaxed.context_notes: Dog is comfortable and at ease. Body is loose and fluid.

standing_alert.label: Alert Standing
standing_alert.description: Weight slightly forward, muscles tense, mouth closed, ears forward
standing_alert.context_notes: Dog has detected something interesting or concerning. Evaluating situation.

forward_lean.label: Forward Lean/Lunge Posture
forward_lean.description: Body weight shifted forward, chest out, standing tall
forward_lean.context_notes: Warning posture. Dog is trying to appear larger. May escalate if the perceived threat doesn't back off.

cowering.label: Cowering/Crouching
cowering.description: Body low to ground, head lowered, trying to appear small
cowering.context_notes: Dog is frightened and trying to make themselves as small as possible. Needs reassurance and space.

belly_up.label: Belly Up/Roll Over
belly_up.context_notes: Context-dependent: relaxed body = trust/requesting belly rubs. Tense body with averted gaze = submissive/appeasement.

stiff_freeze.label: Freeze/Stiffening
stiff_freeze.description: Sudden stillness with rigid body, hard stare
stiff_freeze.context_notes: CRITICAL WARNING. Dog has gone still before deciding fight or flight. Do not approach. Back away slowly.

whale_eye.label: Whale Eye (Showing Whites)
whale_eye.description: Head turned away but eyes looking back, showing whites of eyes (sclera)
whale_eye.context_notes: Dog is uncomfortable with something near them. Often seen when guarding resources or when touched in a way they dislike.

sitting_relaxed.label: Relaxed Sitting
sitting_relaxed.description: Sitting with weight back, mouth open, relaxed expression
sitting_relaxed.context_notes: Dog is comfortable and calm. May be waiting for something or simply resting.

lying_relaxed.label: Relaxed Lying Down
lying_relaxed.description: Lying down with legs extended or curled, body loose
lying_relaxed.context_notes: Dog is very comfortable and feels safe in their environment.

raised_full.label: Full Piloerection
raised_full.description: Hair raised from neck to tail base
raised_full.context_notes: Involuntary response to strong emotions. Not always aggression - can be fear, excitement, or uncertainty. Always indicates heightened emotional state.

raised_shoulders.label: Shoulder Hackles
raised_shoulders.description: Hair raised only on shoulders/upper back
raised_shoulders.context_notes: Often indicates confidence rather than fear. Dog is asserting themselves.

open_relaxed.label: Open, Relaxed (Smiling)
open_relaxed.description: Mouth open with tongue out, relaxed jaw
open_relaxed.context_notes: Classic 'happy dog face'. Tongue may be lolling. Indicates comfort.

closed_tight.label: Closed, Tight Lips
closed_tight.description: Mouth firmly closed with lips pressed together
closed_tight.context_notes: Dog is tense or focused. Combined with hard eyes = warning.

lip_licking.label: Lip Licking (Not After Eating)
lip_licking.description: Quick tongue flicks over lips when not eating
lip_licking.context_notes: Calming signal / stress indicator. Dog is trying to defuse tension.

yawning.label: Yawning (Not Tired)
yawning.context_notes: Displacement behavior indicating stress. Also used as a calming signal to others.

teeth_bared_snarl.label: Snarl / Teeth Bared
teeth_bared_snarl.description: Lips pulled back showing teeth with wrinkled muzzle
teeth_bared_snarl.context_notes: CLEAR WARNING. Dog is threatening to bite. Do not approach. Give maximum space.

panting_heavy.label: Heavy Panting
panting_heavy.description: Rapid, open-mouth breathing beyond what temperature warrants
panting_heavy.context_notes: Context-dependent. After exercise or in heat = normal thermoregulation. In calm, cool setting = stress indicator.

soft_squinting.label: Soft Eyes / Squinting
soft_squinting.context_notes: Sign of affection and contentment. 'Slow blinks' are often a sign of love.

hard_stare.label: Hard Stare / Fixed Gaze
hard_stare.description: Unblinking, intense, fixed stare with dilated pupils
hard_stare.context_notes: SERIOUS WARNING. Direct, unbroken eye contact is a challenge in dog language. Combined with stiff body = imminent aggression.

averted_gaze.label: Averted Gaze / Looking Away
averted_gaze.description: Deliberately looking away, avoiding eye contact
averted_gaze.context_notes: Calming signal. Dog is trying to appear non-threatening or is uncomfortable.

wide_whale_eye.label: Whale Eye (Sclera Showing)
wide_whale_eye.description: Head turned but eyes looking sideways, whites of eyes visible
wide_whale_eye.context_notes: Dog is uncomfortable. Often seen during unwanted handling or resource guarding.
